BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
